data.content_ref: inline:SRC_04 asserts 'strictly more resilient' decentralized design diversity as a natural property, but the mechanism is only 'different teams will naturally exhibit design diversity.' This is a correlation heuristic, not a causal mechanism for independence. The target itself admits a countercondition: all decentralized operators using the same open-source library negates design independence. Since that countercondition is a realistic causal pathway, the 'strictly more resilient' claim is not entailed by the mechanism; it depends on unstated evidence that natural diversity actually persists under real-world convergence pressures.
